title: diospyros ferrea var. ebenus
intro: Diospyros ferrea var. ebenus, commonly known as Ebony Diospyros, is a plant species belonging to the family Ebenaceae. It has been traditionally used in various cultures for its medicinal properties, which include alleviating fever, pain, and inflammation, as well as supporting respiratory health. The health benefits of Ebony Diospyros include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial effects, which can be attributed to its therapeutic actions such as analgesic, anti-pyretic, and expectorant properties. The bioactive constituents present in Ebony Diospyros include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
